sources.title: Work orders overview
sources.scope: Fetched primary body for Maximo Manage continuous-delivery work-order overview.
supported_claims: A work order specifies a task and the labor, materials, services, and tools required for it.
sources.limitations: No equipment condition, physical maintenance instructions, authorization or scheduling algorithm is established by this source.

sources.title: Scheduling work based on resource availability
sources.scope: Fetched primary body describing Maximo Manage Graphical Scheduling availability review.
supported_claims: Planning considers start/end requirements and craft, asset, location, item and tool availability.
The documented planning process checks resource availability and adjusts schedules.
sources.limitations: The fictional greedy search, capacities, kit policy and priorities are not IBM's solver, a standard, or safe-to-work clearance.

sources.title: Resource planning in schedules
sources.scope: Fetched primary body for required/available craft hours and other resource calendars.
supported_claims: Resource views distinguish required and available craft hours.
Other resource availability includes assets, locations, items and tools with calendar context.
sources.limitations: Calendar availability is planning evidence, not a physical, legal or safety authorization. No industry-wide staffing, work-window or overtime standard is inferred.
